messages:
Priya (docs): FYI: TypeScript SDK 2.0.0-alpha is published. Major shape change: generation responses are now objects: { content, tokens, meta } instead of a plain string. See migration guide: https://redwood.example.com/docs/sdk/ts/migration-2-0

Marco (eng-ts): That's breaking for direct string usage. Any compatibility plan?

Priya (docs): We added a client flag legacyText: true to return the old string shape. Server accepts both for 45 days; enforcement will roll out regionally after that.

Hana (product): We'll need console banners and targeted emails to TS-heavy tenants (>500k tokens/month). Jordan (release) to schedule.

Omar (qa): Noted. Examples/tests in examples/ts-quickstarts assert strings. I'll open PRs to update to resp.content and add e2e that validates both shapes.

Riley (devex): Can docs include a quick codemod and short find/replace examples? That helps adoption.

Priya (docs): Yep. Quick snippet for migration added to the guide and quickstart:

```ts
// OLD (v1.x)
const text = await client.generate("Write a haiku")
console.log(text)

// NEW (v2.0)
const resp = await client.generate("Write a haiku")
console.log(resp.content)
```

Priya (docs): Action items: 1) Publish codemod + guide (done), 2) Quickstart update PR (open), 3) Console banner (release), 4) Targeted emails queued, 5) Examples updated by QA PRs.

Marco (eng-ts): Added runtime header X-Redwood-Legacy-Response: true for tenants needing more time. We'll also gate enforcement with a feature flag.

Hana (product): Thank you. If customers break during rollout, contact @Marco (eng-ts) and @Hana (product) for a temporary grace window.

docs-bot: changelog entry created -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/ts-2.0-alpha (updated by Priya (docs)).

Omar (qa): Alpha published to npm dist-tag `alpha`. Reminder: do not pin `latest` in examples. CI will run tests against both `alpha` and `latest`.

Priya (docs): Closing thread 39 DM me if you need tenant-specific migration checklists.
